test_overview: Evaluated the Furniture Items CSV Upload (Merge by SKU) feature against the running app at http://localhost:8000. All three steps passed. Step 1: Uploaded furniture_merge.csv via Admin > Catalog 'Upload Furniture Items CSV' — single-step upload=apply flow (accepted by the plan); success banner 'Catalog merged: 2 inserted, 1 updated.' with a timestamp; catalog reflected S002 updated to 'Dining Table - Large' (1.50) plus inserted S004/S005. Step 2: Calculator reflected the merge — S004 'Bookshelf - 0.80 m³' available and S002 displayed at 1.50 m³; B2C calculation (Warehouse Central → Easton/Riverside; S002×1, S004×2; all services zero) produced badge 'Exact Match', rate $115.00 (lowest exact-match rate), total volume 3.10 m³, base delivery $356.50, total $356.50. Step 3: furniture_duplicate_sku.csv (two S006 rows) was rejected: 'Upload failed — no changes were applied. Row 3: Duplicate SKU 'S006' within the file.'; catalog remained unchanged (no S006/Lamp/Floor Lamp; prior merges intact). Full score: 25/25.

steps.description: test_merge_furniture_success_counts: Uploaded furniture_merge.csv in Admin > Catalog. File accepted; single-step upload=apply flow (allowed by plan). Success: 'Catalog merged: 2 inserted, 1 updated.' (inserted=2, updated=1) with timestamp displayed. Catalog table showed S002 updated to 1.50 and new S004/S005 rows. All verifications (incl. non-fatal) passed.

test_calculator_reflects_merged_items: Calculator catalog selector included S004 (Bookshelf 0.80 m³) and S002 at updated 1.50 m³ (not 1.00). B2C calc with origin Warehouse Central, Easton/Riverside, S002 qty1 + S004 qty2, services zero. Result: 'Exact Match' badge, rate $115.00 (lowest exact-match), total volume 3.10 m³, base delivery $356.50 (115.00×3.10), total $356.50. All verifications passed.

test_duplicate_sku_in_file_rejected: furniture_duplicate_sku.csv rejected — 'Upload failed — no changes were applied. Row 3: Duplicate SKU 'S006' within the file.' No success result; apply blocked. Catalog unchanged: no S006/Lamp/Floor Lamp; previously merged changes (S002 1.50, S004 present) intact. All verifications (incl. non-fatal) passed.
